description: Example excerpt: one measured, one computable and one blocked metric, one headline item and one operational diagnostic. The full registry is contracts/metrics/metric_registry.json.

canonical.section: CANONICAL EVAL STRATEGY (sections 8, 9; Frontier V5, V6)

operational_diagnostics.name: Model / token efficiency
operational_diagnostics.blocker: Not collected: no per-episode usage, latency or cost record is defined and the metrics harness reads none of these quantities.

metrics.name: Entity attachment (identity resolution P/R)
metrics.definition: Pairwise precision and recall of identity clustering: raw identities (email, CRM ids, speakers, Slack) attached to the right person/account entity.

formula.numerator: predicted same-entity identity pairs that are gold pairs (P) / gold pairs predicted (R)

har97_ref.quote: Did we attach activities to the right account/person?

current_value.display: P 1.000 / R 1.000 on 111 gold identity pairs
current_value.caveat: Measured on the legacy fixture world: invented fixture accounts (Acme, Beta, Northstar), not real customer data, with author-written gold identities.

metrics.name: Recipient correctness pass rate
metrics.definition: Share of proposed actions that pass the deterministic 'Recipient correctness' eval (code, no LLM).

gold: fixtures/evals/cases (87 gold GTM situations): expected[] with eval_type recipient_correctness

metrics.notes: Deterministic evaluator on main (HAR-115, core-go/internal/evals/deterministic). Go TestGoldAgreement scores it against the gold deterministic labels (28 of 29 scorable, floor and zero false blocks asserted) and logs the per-eval agreement; the metrics harness does not collect the per-entry rate.

metrics.name: Eval gaming / proxy failure (V6)
metrics.definition: Whether the agent can raise the measured score without improving the real GTM outcome.

formula.procedure: Held-out adversarial cases (E22.1-E22.9), outcome checks and human review: score gain with no outcome or human-quality gain counts as proxy failure.

har97_ref.quote: Audit whether the agent can improve the measured score without improving the real GTM outcome.

metrics.blocker: No adversarial or gaming cases exist (E22.1-E22.9 are planned) and there are no outcome checks to compare against.
